name: mindos-memory
description: MindBoost persistent Memory Layer (RAG) for Claude Code. Local-first: Markdown files in git are the source of truth; an embedded sqlite-vec + FTS5 index gives hybrid keyword+vector retrieval. Core runs on built-in Node only; vector search is an optional, gracefully-degrading enhancement.

comments.why-optional: sqlite-vec (vector index) and @huggingface/transformers (local embeddings) are OPTIONAL. If absent or failing to install on this machine, the engine degrades to FTS5 keyword-only search and still works fully. node:sqlite, FTS5, node:crypto and node:test are built into Node 24 and need no install.
comments.windows: sqlite-vec ships a prebuilt loadable extension via the sqlite-vec-windows-x64 dependency it pulls in. If it fails, run keyword-only (set embedder=none in config.json). Never compile from source.
comments.install: Run `npm install` inside .claude/memory/ once to enable vectors. The keyword path needs no install.
